documents.name: dingp_Ath_ATACseq_2019_optimization
documents.longDesc: By using different input numbers after FANS with 5-week-old short-day-growing Arabidopsis leaves, we found using 0.1uL Nextera Tn5 within 5uL reactions, 10k, 20k, 50k and 80k nuclei input can all give good peaks for open chromatin signatures. Finally we chose 10k for the following up experiments.

documents.name: 10k
documents.conditions: 22 C, shortday, 70% humidity. JIC B5108 CER room. 5 week old. 2 fully expanded leaves per plant. Freshly collected and chopped with chopping buffer, then stained with DAPI for FANS (BD-FACSmelody sorting) into PBS buffer. Spun down and removal supernatant then add 5 uL tagmentation reaction mix. 37 C incubation for 30min before following-up library prep.
